label: Regions — List + Dashboards
note: The 2-tab Regions element. Composite MFE on the pane-wrapper layout, imitating my-upg-100-list/upg-100-mfe: a SELECT VIEW switcher (library/components/ViewSelect.vue) over Regions List at [0,0] and Region Dashboards at [1,0]. Clicking a region or country on tab 1 forwards the selection on 'doxa-regions-dashboard:select' and swaps to tab 2. pinHint:false: the cloned pages carry no coach-mark, and the composite must declare it because a pane's config comes from here, not from the child's own meta.
